say:13:1220216009:1.text: Many people have been getting sick by drinking the fresh water here. We can buy juice to drink, but it's too expensive to drink every day.

say:14:1220216010:1.text: So what's left is ale, which is cheap and makes them happy. Many people here drink it like water.

say:15:1220216011:1.text: Unbelievable. Using beer instead of water to the point that they turn into drunks...
say:15:1220216011:1.source_cn: 简直难以置信，用酒来代替水，甚至把自己喝成了酒鬼……

say:16:1220216012:1.text: Chippy's heard pirates do this, but never thought this would happen on land!
say:16:1220216012:1.source_cn: 满满虽然听说过有的海盗会这样，但没想到陆地上也会发生这种事！

say:17:1220216013:1.text: Either way, if they keep drinking day in and day out, even if they don't cause trouble, their bodies will eventually pay the price.
say:17:1220216013:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，他们如果这样一天到晚醉醺醺的，就算不惹出事...
